description.subtitle: FC Barcelona Fermín's Nike second kit children's set for the Champions 2026 2027 - black, purple
description.tagline: The complete kit for future stars
description.intro: The Nike children's kit for the FC Barcelona 26 27 Dri-Fit Stadium away kit allows the little ones to wear the complete kit inspired by what the professionals wear. Its black and purple design pays tribute to the bond between Kobe Bryant and the Barça club, representing the attention to detail and the constant search for excellence.
key_benefits: Nike Dri-FIT Technology: Helps keep skin dry and comfortable during play.
Complete set: Includes matching t-shirt, shorts and socks.
Stadium Design: Replica of the official FCB uniform.
Light fabric: Promotes mobility and comfort.
Elastic waist: Comfortable fit on the shorts.
Barça 26 27 Design: Inspired by the competitive mentality and legacy shared between FC Barcelona and Kobe Bryant.

Su diseño en negro y púrpura rinde homenaje al vínculo entre Kobe Bryant y el club azulgrana, representando la atención por los detalles y la búsqueda constante de la excelencia.
